title: can과 could (할 수 있어요 / 할 수 있었어요)
goal: can으로 지금 할 수 있는 일과 못 하는 일을, could로 예전에 할 수 있었던 일과 못 했던 일을 말할 수 있어요.

points.title: can = ~할 수 있어요
points.body: 할 수 있는 일은 can + 동사원형으로 말해요. I can make coffee.는 '저 커피 만들 수 있어요'예요. 동사원형은 -s, -ing, -ed가 안 붙은 기본 모양이에요.

points.title: can은 모양이 안 바뀌어요
points.body: 주어가 He / She여도 can에 s를 붙이지 않고, 뒤 동사에도 s를 붙이지 않아요. She can drive. (O) / She cans drive. (X) / She can drives. (X)

points.title: 못 해요 = can't
points.body: '~할 수 없어요, 못 해요'는 can't(= cannot) + 동사원형이에요. I can't swim.처럼 써요.

points.title: could = ~할 수 있었어요 (과거)
points.body: could는 can의 과거형이에요. 예전에 할 수 있었던 일은 could, 못 했던 일은 couldn't + 동사원형이에요. I couldn't sleep last night. (어젯밤에 잠을 못 잤어요)

points.title: 질문과 대답
points.body: can / could를 맨 앞으로 옮기면 질문이에요. Can you drive? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't. 과거는 Could you ~? — Yes, I could. / No, I couldn't. do / did는 필요 없어요.

formula: Yes, 주어 + can(could). / No, 주어 + can't(couldn't).

mistakes.why: She 뒤에는 동사에 s를 붙인다고 배워서 헷갈려요. can 뒤 동사는 항상 동사원형이에요.
질문을 Do로 시작하는 습관 때문이에요. can이 있으면 Can을 맨 앞에 두면 끝이에요.

mistakes.wrong: I can't find my keys yesterday.
mistakes.right: I couldn't find my keys yesterday.
mistakes.why: yesterday처럼 지나간 일이면 can't가 아니라 과거형 couldn't를 써요.

examples.en: She can speak English and Korean.
examples.ko: 그녀는 영어랑 한국어를 할 수 있어요.

examples.en: I can't drive a manual car.
examples.ko: 저는 수동 차는 운전 못 해요.

examples.en: Can you lift heavy boxes? — Yes, I can.
examples.ko: 무거운 상자 들 수 있어요? — 네, 들 수 있어요.

examples.en: I could swim when I was five.
examples.ko: 저는 다섯 살 때 수영할 수 있었어요.

examples.en: I couldn't sleep last night. It was too hot.
examples.ko: 어젯밤에 잠을 못 잤어요. 너무 더웠어요.

examples.en: We couldn't find a parking spot at the beach.
Could you understand the Aussie accent at first? — No, I couldn't.
examples.ko: 처음에 호주 억양 알아들을 수 있었어요? — 아니요, 못 알아들었어요.

quiz.ko: 저는 영어를 조금 할 수 있어요.

quiz.sentence: Sorry, I ___ come to work today. I'm sick.
quiz.ko: 죄송해요, 오늘 출근 못 해요. 아파요.

quiz.sentence: I ___ sleep last night. My housemate was too loud.
quiz.ko: 어젯밤에 잠을 못 잤어요. 쉐어메이트가 너무 시끄러웠어요.

quiz.sentence: When he was young, he ___ run really fast.
quiz.ko: 그는 어렸을 때 정말 빨리 달릴 수 있었어요.
quiz.why: When he was young은 과거니까 could. could에도 s는 안 붙어요.

quiz.answer: I couldn't find my keys last night.
choices: I couldn't find my keys last night.
I can't find my keys last night.
I couldn't found my keys last night.
I didn't could find my keys last night.
quiz.why: 과거에 못 한 일은 couldn't + 동사원형. found가 아니라 find.

choices: We can to work on weekends.
quiz.why: can + 동사원형, can은 모양이 안 바뀌어요.

quiz.ko: 운전할 수 있어요? — 네, 할 수 있어요.
quiz.answer: Can you drive? — Yes, I can.
choices: Do you can drive? — Yes, I do.
Can you drive? — Yes, I do.
Can you drive? — Yes, I can.
Can you driving? — Yes, I can.

quiz.answer: My housemate can cook Thai food.
choices: My housemate can cook Thai food.
My housemate cans cook Thai food.
My housemate can cooks Thai food.
My housemate can to cook Thai food.
quiz.why: can에도, 뒤 동사에도 s를 붙이지 않아요.

choices: Does she can drive a truck?
quiz.why: Can + 주어 + 동사원형? Does는 필요 없어요.

quiz.answer: She could read when she was four.
choices: She could reads when she was four.
She could read when she was four.
She can read when she was four.
She could to read when she was four.
quiz.why: when she was four는 과거니까 could + 동사원형.
